title: fxtra
description: This project adds a lot of features that i think would make the game easier to beat or use.
body: This mod *(fxtra)* currently adds an obsidian crafting recipe and obsidian powder to craft the obsidian. This mod focuses on ways to make the game more fun and enjoyable. We also take your ideas into the game and you can have fun with it. However, we unfortunately cant make complicated requests like "Purple TNT That destroys half of the map" but we can make re-textured or re-modeled mobs like a creepier wither. I recommend this mod if you are wanting to push minecraft to another level and i would really appreciate if you tried my mod out. **If you have ideas please post it in the comments or discord** Thanks for supporting my mod.
